wholeProspectiveGoalWithCorrectedEN.titleEn: Interpret coordinate bonding in Fehling test
wholeProspectiveGoalWithCorrectedEN.description: Die lernende Person kann die Ausbildung koordinativer Bindungen zwischen Zentralatom oder Zentralion und Liganden durch unbesetzte Orbitale am Zentralatom oder Zentralion sowie freie Elektronenpaare am Liganden erlaeutern und am Beispiel der Fehling-Probe deuten.
wholeProspectiveGoalWithCorrectedEN.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the formation of coordinate bonds between a central atom or ion and ligands using unoccupied orbitals at the central atom or ion and lone pairs at the ligand, and interpret this using the Fehling test as an example.

actualScienceFinding: Right panel under Fehling-Komplex shows four tartrate figures each with two red Cu connections, eight connections. A complete Fehling coordination shell with eight shown donor connections is not supported by the original primary Fehling species.

primarySource.title: The Structural Chemistry of Text-Book Species: the Tartrato-Cuprates in Fehling’s Solution
primarySource.paraphrasedRelevantFacts: The isolated bis(diolato) species closest in stoichiometry to typical Fehling recipes is square-planar and tetracoordinate. Two other isolated mixed carboxylato/alkoxido species have4+1 coordination. These are actual crystal species; the abstract does not justify a universally asserted eight-coordinate whole Fehling complex.

correctionDecision: REVISE only the documented standalone image weakness; retain warm friendly comic style and blue/coral model characters. Show a clearly labelled local model excerpt with one occupied ligand donor pair and appropriate vacant central acceptor, no asserted full complex geometry/stoichiometry/redox.
